data.gender_notes: Baqaaya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'baqaa', meaning 'to remain, continue, or exist'. Baqaaya signifies the one who is self-sufficient and sustained by Allah. The name Baqaaya carries the meaning “Sustenance, Provision” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baqaaya usually hope their child will grow to embody sustenance, provision and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rooted in trust and reliance on Allah's provision.
data.etymology: Baqaaya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sustenance, Provision.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baqaaya total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: بقايا
